scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Complete five-state paired CAD reference numerical qualification and independent audit after sparse column ordering changes

all_original_arrays_and_fields.scope: Qualify a reference linear-solver change against every original saved array and complete stress field.
all_original_arrays_and_fields.limitations: A changed sparse ordering is qualified only on this complete saved prefix, with a byte-identical original initializer and unchanged physical equations/tolerances. Numerical equivalence and reference solve acceleration do not establish contact/geometry convergence, full application/history, model/feedback accuracy or warmed production cost.

independent_all_state_audit.scope: Independently verify every precision-aware spatial state and its unaveraged global field.
independent_all_state_audit.limitations: Every original dynamic step is independently reconstructed, including exact previous-state/velocity integration, unsmoothed centered normal/friction stencils, mass/armature and capped jaw PD. Raw global wide-coordinate field bounds remain visible. The original fixed-arm/two-jaw control and saved held initializer remain explicit. Full-arm application matching and physical spatial/contact/geometry convergence are separate incomplete requirements.

summary.limitations: Only a sparse column permutation changes. Original geometry/material/mass, initializer, controls/history, force budgets and internal tolerances remain fixed. One7680-tet five-state baseline has complete array/corner/quadrature/raw-peak comparison and a separate independent force/global-field audit. Timings are single reference runs on different nodes; their descriptive ratio is not a controlled ordering speedup, warmed production rate or physical accuracy. Fine30720-tet baseline/candidate and adaptive references remain live and excluded; no cancellation/replacement is claimed. Full physical/contact/geometry/history/model/feedback/verified-cost acceptance remains open.

limitations: All five original7680-tet CAD states retain every saved array, complete corner/quadrature stress and raw peak within unchanged numerical gates after a sparse column-ordering change. A separate independent all-state audit passes original force gates. Fifteen linear solves and one fresh factor per path give descriptive reference timings on different nodes, not a controlled speedup, warmed native cost or physical convergence. Production remains unchanged; all live fine/adaptive producers are excluded. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
